content: Izři n Hanna
Xenni teẓẓuǧ Ḥanna, tenna: “Uř inu ittesřiwřiw s řefraḥet di SIDI. Icc inu ittwassgeɛɛed di SIDI. Aqemmum inu yarzem d arzam x řɛedyan inu, maɣar farḥeɣ x usenjem nnec.
Uřa d ijj d amqeddes am SIDI, maɣar war din iǧi ḥed mɣir Cek, u war din teǧi teṣḍart am AREBBI nneɣ!
War tarennim tessawařem ammu s nnfaxet, war dd-tteffiɣ uřa d ca n tuffet zeg uqemmum nwem, maɣar SIDI d ijj n Arebbi issen marra, timegga nnes ttwaweznent.
Řqews n ayt n bu-teɣruḍt ittwarẓa, maca inni inqarḍen ḥezzmen s jjhed.
Inni ijjiwnen arehnen ixef nsen i weɣrum, maca inni iǧuẓen, war qqimen ɛad ǧuzen. Tenni war ittirwen turuw-dd sebɛa n iḥenjiren, tenni ɣar iǧa ubarru n iḥenjiren, tisřaw.
AREBBI ineqq u ittic tudart, Netta isshekkʷwa ɣar řaxart u issgeɛɛad-dd ssenni.
SIDI ittarra ijj d amezřuḍ u ijj nneɣni yarra i-t d bu-wagřa, isshekkwa d issgeɛɛad.

Amuqřiř issekkar i-t zi tɛejjajt, řmeskin ijebd i-t-i-dd zeg wefraḍ, maḥend ad ten issɣim ɣar tarwa n taṣiřet, maḥend ad iwc ijj n řkursi n řɛezz d řwart, minzi dsusa n temmurt iǧan n SIDI u Netta issbedd xasen ddunect.
Netta i issřeqqan x iṣuraf n imtiqqan nnes, maca iɛeffanen ad ttwassbekmen di taǧest, minzi aryaz war ittiři ca d bu teɣruḍt zi jjehd n yixef nnes.
Wenni ittemcubbucen ak-d SIDI, ad ittwarẓ. Ad xasen isshemhem deg ujenna. SIDI ad iḥkem tineggura n ddunect, ad iwc tizemmar i ujeǧid uca ad issgeɛɛed icc n lmasiḥ nnes.”
Iḥenjiren n Ɛali
Iɛqeb Ilqana ɛawed ɣar taddart nnes ɣar Rama, maca aḥenjir isexxar i SIDI zzat i wudem n ukehhan Ɛali.
Maca tarwa n Ɛali tuɣa d tarwa i war isekkwin. Nitni war ssinen ca SIDI.

Ikehhanen nnumen ad ggen ak-d řgens ammu: mařa yiwi ijj n weryaz ict n tɣarṣt, xenni, umi tuɣa aysum ɛad ittnenna, yusa-dd ijj n umsexxar n ikehhanen ak-d ict n furcita n třata n icukḍan deg ufus nnes,
ijju tt di řburmet niɣ deg uṭenjir niɣ di marmita niɣ di teydurt u marra min ɣa teksi furcita, iksi t ukehhan i yixef nnes. Ammu i t ggin ɣar marra ayt n Israil inni dd-yusin ɣar Cilu.

Ammu ɛawed, qbeř ɣa bexxaren tadunt, yusa-dd ijj n umsexxar n ikehhanen, inna i weryaz nni dd-iwyen taɣarṣt: “Ewc ayi aysum ḥima ad t qřiɣ i ukehhan, minzi netta war xak iksi ca aysum ittwanennan, maca mɣir aziza.”

Mařa yarra-dd xas weryaz: “Amezwar ittxeṣṣa ad bexxaren tadunt marra, xenni ksi min ixs wuř nnec i yixef nnec!”, inna as umsexxar n ukehhan: “Lla, ittxeṣṣa ad t tewced řexxu, mařa lla, ad t ksiɣ s uɣiř!”
Ddenb n imsexxaren tuɣa imɣar aṭṭas zzat i wudem n SIDI, maɣar iryazen sseḥqaren tawhibt n řɣiǧet n SIDI.
Maca Camwil tuɣa ittsexxar zzat i wudem n SIDI, aqa-t d ijj n uḥenjir iḥezzmen s yijj n upalṭu n ukehhan n řeqṭen.
Yemmas tegga as ijj n useřham uca tᵉttawyi as t-i-dd zeg useggʷas ɣar useggʷas, xmi tᵉttgeɛɛed ak-d weryaz nnes ḥima ad tawi din taɣarṣt n kuř aseggʷas.

Igga Ɛali lbaraka di Ilqana d temɣart nnes, inna: “Iři ad ac iwc SIDI zi temɣart-a ijj n uḥenjir deg wemcan n uḥenjir i tsellem nettat, deg wemcan n uḥenjir i immewcen i SIDI.” Xenni ɛeqben nitni ɣar wemcan n tzeddiɣt nnes.
SIDI maca ixzar ɣar Ḥanna u nettat teksi s ddeyset uca turuw-dd třata n iḥenjiren d tnayen n tḥenjirin, am tuɣa imeqqar Camwil ameẓyan ɣar SIDI.
Idweř Ɛali iwsar aṭṭas. Netta isřa x marra min ggin iḥenjiren nnes i marra Israil uca isřa ɛawed aqa nitni ṭṭṣen ak-d temɣarin i tuɣa ttsexxarent ɣar wadaf n Uqiḍun n Umsagar.
Netta inna asen: “Mayemmi tᵉtteggem aya ammu, ařami i ttesřiɣ zi marra řgens-a x tmegga nwem tiɛeffanin?
Lla, a iḥenjiren inu, aya war iǧi d ijj n řexbar iḥřa i sřiɣ. Kenniw tᵉttarram řgens-a n SIDI ad iwḍa di xeṭṭu.

Mařa ijj n bnadem ixḍa ak-d ijj bnadem nneɣni, xenni ad xas iḥkem AREBBI, maca mařa ijj n bnadem ad ixḍa x SIDI, wi xas ɣa iwten?” Waxxa amenni nitni war sřin ca ɣar babatsen, maɣar SIDI tuɣa ixs ad ten ineɣ.
Maca Camwil ameẓyan tuɣa imeqqar uca yarni ittas-dd x řxaḍar i SIDI uřa ɣar iwdan.
Awař n Arebbi x Ɛali d tarwa nnes
Uca yusa-dd ijj n weryaz n SIDI ɣar Ɛali, inna as: “Ammu i iqqar SIDI: ‘Ma war i d ssecneɣ ixef inu nican i taddart n babac umi ten tuɣa di Miṣra, di taddart n firɛun?

Necc farzeɣ t zi marra tiqebbař n Israil d akehhan i Necc maḥend ad igeɛɛed ɣar uɛalṭar inu ḥima ad din issarɣ řebxur u maḥend ad yarḍ apalṭu n ukehhan zzat i wudem inu. Necc wciɣ ɛawed i taddart n babac marra tiɣarṣa n tmessi n ayt n Israil.

Mayemmi tɛeffsem kenniw x tɣarṣt inu d tewhibt n řɣiǧet i zi umureɣ maḥend ad tent twehhbem di Tzeddiɣt inu, u mayemmi tᵉttweqqarem iḥenjiren nwem aṭṭas xafi umi tmesřem kenniw ixef nwem s mummu n marra tiwhibin n řɣiǧet n řgens inu Israil?’

S uya iqqar SIDI, AREBBI n Israil: ‘Necc nniɣ nican: Taddart nnec d taddart n babac ad uyurent zzat i wudem inu i řebda!’, maca řexxu iqqar SIDI: ‘Aya aqa iggʷej xafi, maɣar inni d ayi ittweqqaren, ad ten weqqareɣ, maca inni i d ayi isseḥqaran, ad ttwaḥesben d imuqřiřen.
Xzar ad asen wussan, ad qeḍɛeɣ aɣiř nnec d uɣiř n taddart n babac ařami war ittiři ɛad d awessar di taddart nnec.
Cek ad texzared belli ad dd-yas ijj n weɣrim n Tzeddiɣt, waxxa Netta ittegg tcuni-ya marra i Israil, uca ɛemmarṣ ad yiři ɛad ijj n uwessar di taddart nnec, marra ussan.
War qeṭṭɛeɣ ca kuř aryaz i ɣ̮arek iǧan x uɛalṭar inu, ařami ɣa uḥřent tiṭṭawin nnec qaɛ, ad tefna řeɛmar nnec uca marra arraw n taddart nnec ad mmten d iryazen.
D ta i d ak ɣa tiři d řeɛřamet nni dd ɣa tas x tnayen n iḥenjiren nnec, Ḥufni d Finaḥas: ad mmten s tnayen deg ijj n wass.
Necc maca ad ggeɣ i Ixef inu ijj n ukehhan d amtiqqi. Netta ad igg ɛlaḥsab uř d řeɛmar inu. Necc ad as ssbeddeɣ ict n taddart temten uca netta ad yuyur řebda zzat i wudem n lmasiḥ inu.

Uca ad imsar, belli marra wi ɣa iqqimen zi taddart nnec, ad dd-yas ad as ibendeq i yict n tuqiyyat n nnuqart niɣ i yict n tecnift n weɣrum, ad yini: ‘Arni ayi mɣir ɣar ict n řxedmet n tsexxart n ikehhanen, maḥend ad ɣari yiři ijj n uřeqqim n weɣrum i macca.’”

ɣar babatsen- s Tɛibranit ‘ɣar tmijja n babatsen’.
